description: This file implements the 'git difftool' command, providing functionality to invoke external diff tools for comparing files or directories in a Git repository. It includes options parsing, configuration handling, helper functions for file and symlink handling, directory diff management, and command execution logic.

classes.name: struct difftool_options
classes.description: Holds configuration options for the difftool command, such as symlink handling and exit code trust.

classes.name: struct working_tree_entry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the working tree, used for managing file comparisons.

classes.name: struct pair_entry
classes.description: Stores pairs of file paths and their associated metadata for directory difference comparisons.

classes.name: struct path_entry
classes.description: Represents a path entry in hashmaps used during directory diff computations.

methods.name: int difftool_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Handles configuration options for the difftool, such as trusting exit codes and handling symlinks.

methods.name: int print_tool_help(void)
methods.description: Displays a list of available diff tools and help information.

methods.name: int parse_index_info(struct repository * repo,char * p,int * mode1,int * mode2,struct object_id * oid1,struct object_id * oid2,char * status)
methods.description: Parses index information lines from diff outputs, extracting modes, object IDs, and status.

methods.name: void add_path(struct strbuf * buf,size_t base_len,const char * path)
methods.description: Adds a relative or absolute path to a strbuf, ensuring proper formatting.

methods.name: int use_wt_file(struct repository * repo,const char * workdir,const char * name,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Determines if a working tree file can be reused based on its object ID and filesystem state.

methods.name: char * get_symlink(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const struct object_id * oid,const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves symlink content either from the filesystem or object database, depending on it being known to Git.

methods.name: int checkout_path(unsigned mode,struct object_id * oid,const char * path,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Writes the specified object ID to the provided path in the working directory.

methods.name: void write_file_in_directory(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * dir,size_t dir_len,const char * path,const char * content)
methods.description: Writes file content to a specified directory and ensures parent directories exist.

methods.name: void write_standin_files(struct repository * repo,struct pair_entry * entry,struct strbuf * ldir,size_t ldir_len,struct strbuf * rdir,size_t rdir_len)
methods.description: Creates temporary placeholder files for submodules and symlinks for directory diffs.

methods.name: int run_dir_diff(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const char * extcmd,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Performs directory diff operations, managing temporary directories, invoking an external diff tool, and handling working tree modifications.

methods.name: int run_file_diff(int prompt,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Runs diff for individual files, setting up environment variables appropriately.

methods.name: int cmd_difftool(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git difftool' command, parsing command-line options, configuring environment, and dispatching to directory or file diff routines.
